name: Track list
summary: An album or playlist: a drawn cover, title and artist, play, shuffle and save, then numbered tracks with their length, an explicit tag, a like heart and the playing one marked.
use: on an album, playlist or mixtape page
a11y: An ordered list where each whole row is one button that names the track, number and length; the playing row has aria-current, and like, save and shuffle are toggle buttons with aria-pressed.
